newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Crepe prices down at Colombo auction.
newsitem.headline: Crepe prices down at Colombo auction.

text.p: Crepe prices fell at the Colombo auction on Thursday reflecting buyers' comfortable stock levels, but brokers said prices could rise if rain in tapping areas did not cease in the next week or two.
"People are covered so they are not in a hurry to buy," said a buyer. "They are now looking for forward purchases."
Best latex crepe one-x fell to 72.25 rupees per kg from 75 at the previous action on Tuesday. Number one fell to 71.25 rupees from 74 rupees while RSS1 rose to 64 rupees from 63.
Brokers said 142 tonnes of crepe and 24 tonnes of sheet rubber were offered, up from 119 and 17 on Tuesday.
